preconditions.description: The length of the permutation n is between 1 and 50000 inclusive.
The value of 2k is between 0 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains a permutation of the integers from 1 to 2n.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(int(stdout.split()[2 * i - 1]) - int(stdout.split()[2 * i])) for i in range(1, n + 1)) - abs(sum(int(stdout.split()[2 * i - 1]) - int(stdout.split()[2 * i]) for i in range(1, n + 1))) == 2 * k
postconditions.description: The equation sum of absolute differences minus the absolute value of the sum of differences equals 2k.
